thread:
emma: FYI customer (acme-corp) reporting 401s in EU after we rotated their API key at ~03:12 UTC. Affected: payments-worker-prod behind SSOConnect proxy. Logs show old key still in use.
support_jules: Which svc/pods? Any quick repro or sample log?
emma: payments-worker-prod (k8s eu-west). Sample: 
``
2026-03-17T03:18:05Z ERROR http 401 "Unauthorized" path=/v1/generate user=payments-worker
auth_header="Bearer sk_live_OLD...xyz"
```
They say Vault has new key at `secret/data/apps/payments/rdw-api-key` and rotated earlier.
raj: My first guess is sidecar secret injector didn't reload envvars — we've seen in-process env caching + KV v2 version mismatches. Can you collect pod env and sidecar logs? Quick commands:
`kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=payments-worker`
`kubectl exec -n prod payments-worker-... -- env | grep REDWOOD_API_KEY`
`kubectl logs -n prod payments-worker-... -c secret-sidecar | tail -n 50`
emma: Ran those. Pod env shows `REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live_OLD...` Sidecar logs: 
``
INFO fetched secret v2 path=secret/data/apps/payments/rdw-api-key
INFO lease ttl=3600s
INFO no env update required (same value)
```
support_jules: That indicates sidecar thinks value unchanged — maybe the new value was written as a new metadata version (v3) but the sidecar only looks at payload equality or the wrapped KMS key changed. Check Vault KV metadata and secret-ops logs for decrypt/unwrap errors.
raj: Also grep for `error=failed to decrypt` or `unwrap` in secret-ops/kms logs — if rewrap used a different KMS key-id we might have silent unwrap failures.
kai: Short mitigation: restart the RW process or rollout the deployment to pick up the env. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/payments-worker -n prod` — low risk and should restore service quickly. We should also confirm whether Vault KV is v2 and whether sidecar reconciles on metadata/version change.
emma: Did a rollout restart — workers picked up the new key and 401s dropped to 0 within ~45s. Customer confirmed recovery.
support_jules: Good. Actions: 
- sidecar should compare KV metadata version (not only value equality) to detect rotations (owner: eng-ml)
- add a 5-minute rotation grace window for SSOConnect-integrated services (owner: product)
- update triage runbook: when post-rotation 401s -> check pod env, sidecar logs, then rollout restart (owner: support)
- add telemetry: count stale-env incidents and correlation with KV rotations (owner: eng-sre)
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1142 severity=low assigned=support_jules
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-17T03:22:00Z triggered for payments-worker (rollout id=xyz)
kai: Long-term: consider using consul-template or Vault Agent with CT templates to push env updates or implement a listener for KV metadata changes. Also consider emitting a rotation event that other services can subscribe to.
emma: I'll open a support ticket + notify the account team. Customer worried about billing spike from failed calls — FYI failed 401s are not billed. support_jules, can you confirm?
support_jules: Confirmed: 401/unauth requests are not billed. I'll add a doc link to the runbook. Also adding a small snippet for the triage checklist: 
``
# triage checklist
- check pod env: kubectl exec -n prod <pod> -- env | grep REDWOOD_API_KEY
- sidecar logs: kubectl logs -n prod <pod> -c secret-sidecar
- vault kv metadata: vault kv metadata get secret/data/apps/payments/rdw-api-key
- rollout if needed: kubectl rollout restart deployment/payments-worker -n prod
```
emma: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
